content.comment_body: Hello, I'm currently dealing with two issues. I have two screens, and when I try to navigate between them using the down button, it displays the time instead of moving to the next screen. However, if I press ESC+down, it does switch screens. Is it possible to make it work with just button clicks rather than requiring ESC+Down? My second question is about implementing a switch function. I'd like the Left button on my display to activate an output, but I don't want the output to turn off when I release the button. Any assistance would be appreciated.
Please upload your [document] file, preferably as a Zip archive.
Do you want the output to be turned on with the first press of ESC + Cursor left, and then turned off with the next press? Could you clarify your expected behavior?
This was exactly what I needed, although I reversed the logic to suit my requirements. However, now it sometimes requires me to press the button again to reset it.
By the way, I resolved the screen navigation issue by arranging their priority, so now switching between screens works smoothly.
I've resolved this issue as well. Thank you so much; your help has been invaluable.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered issues with navigation and button configuration on a display, specifically needing to use button combinations for screen changes instead of single presses, and wanting to set up a toggle switch rather than a momentary button. With guidance from others, the user was able to solve both problems.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to navigate screens using single button presses rather than combinations, and prefers a button configured to act as a toggle switch, so it remains on or off with each press instead of requiring the button to be held.
